notes.title: Early Access - Week one notes
notes.content:
Howdy partners,

It has been a full week since the release of Speedrun Académie, and we are super hyped by your response! Throughout the week, we've been gathering feedback and building our roadmap. Not only that, but we've also been preparing the event for this weekend.

Today's build is a quick QoL update with refactors and organization on our end. Have a look!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New visual identity!
[*] Level selection screen added
[*] New visual cue for gainer expiration
[*] Tutorial is now fully playable
[*] ... secret level?
[/list]

[h2]Stats[/h2]
[b]101x[/b] Steam sales
[b]1h01m[/b] Median time played
[b]71x[/b] Run completions
[b]25x[/b] Hardcore Run completions
[b]5x[/b] 100% Run completions
[b]9x[/b] Sub 2-minute runs

[b]WR[/b] once again goes to Cuttyflame with 01.53.741, a difference of 13.5 seconds!

[h2]Priorities[/h2]
We're glad to announce that we've laid down a roadmap! Feel free to leave comments or suggestions on that page:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1708070/discussions/0/601899481260133785/]Roadmap[/url]

"Before diving into the feature list, a quick note: these features are not prioritized. We simply work on what excites us at the moment! The game was built alongside the community, and your feedback continues to motivate us and shape the future of development—so keep those comments coming! Lâchez pas les commentaires!"

[h2]Event[/h2]
We're quickly approaching No-Reset 6, and with that comes the Speedrun Académie Challenge @ NoReset VI

More information here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1708070/view/534344758463563744?l=english]No Reset 6 Challenge[/url]

notes.title: Early Access - Day one notes
notes.content:
[b]🚀 Launch Recap & Day 1 Highlights[/b]

We're beyond thrilled with how the release went! The hype around the game has been incredible, and it's great to see players getting hooked on the speedrunning loop—finding faster routes, pushing their limits, and refining their runs. Watching everyone evolve from safe paths to more advanced strats has been amazing.

A huge thank you to everyone who left a review, streamed the game, or shared their experience. Your support is pushing us to make this the best speedrunning game possible.

[b]Day 1 Stats[/b]
[list]
[*] Runs completed: 44
[*] Deathless runs: 15
[*] Perfect runs (no major mistakes): 4
[*] Shortest average segment: Greece
[*] Longest average segment: Crimson
[/list]

[b]Day 1 Record - Cuttyflame[/b]
[list]
[*] Total: 2:07.296
[*] Greece: 0:23.919
[*] Crimson: 0:48.701
[*] Frosty: 0:22.654
[*] Slide: 0:32.022
[/list]

[b]Development Update[/b]
We're working hard to bring a solid experience for No-Reset 6 in Montreal next week. Expect sporadic quality-of-life updates leading up to the event.

[b]Latest Patch[/b]
[list]
[*] Press R to reset your run
[*] Fixed some terrain issues to prevent getting stuck (does not affect times)
[/list]

[b]Roadmap[/b]
[list]
[*] Until March 22: Quality-of-life updates and bug fixes
[*] After March 22: We’ll share the next phase in a dedicated community post
[/list]

Thanks again for playing! Keep grinding, keep finding skips, and keep the feedback coming. Looking forward to seeing what you all achieve next.
